'''2017 European Championship Day 2 Jonas Hagen Nørregaard DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]] at [[2017 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jonas Hagen Nørregaard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210125014231/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2017-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
